svg.title: Application invalidation after a geometry scale or units change
svg.desc: A geometry scale or units change affects collision geometry and clearances, mass and inertia assumptions, joint and drive frames, grasp and affordance frames, and real-space texture scale. The first four dependencies also invalidate task-fitness evidence tied to the former asset.
svg.text: same package lineage · new effective claim
Mass, centre of mass and inertia assumptions
the scaling policy must be stated
recompute mapping against the new real-space scale
Application dependency rules propagate scale changes into downstream re-evaluation.
